verdict.rationale: Cua ships Cua Bench, a benchmarking harness with OSWorld-Verified and other adapters plus task scoring. That lets users run benchmarks themselves, but it is a building block, not published results. The evidence pack contains no vendor-published task-completion results, and a community member explicitly notes the lack of any actual benchmark results on existing models or agents in Cua-Bench.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the vendor publishes task-completion benchmark results (OSWorld or similar) with enough detail to reproduce them

citations.quote: Adapter benchmarks: OSWorld-Verified, MiniWoB++, WebVoyager and other adapters.
Start from a taskset in the Cua Bench registry: one command runs it on this machine.
